account: In June 2025 AI4Africa proposed a deep learning system that detects intrusions in vehicle-to-vehicle (V2V) communication. The team planned to evaluate the system with standard classification metrics. The team states that its deep learning approach offers an advantage over signature-based or rule-based intrusion detection. No intercepted attack or safety improvement has been reported. No paper, code release or ITU update on this system has appeared since June 2025.
